subject: EmberTech trial activation checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@embertech.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@embertech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: EmberTech trial kickoff — proposed activation checklist

Hi Sam / Olivia —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call + a proposed activation checklist so we can get the trial started with clear success criteria and owners. I attached a one-sheet (poc-activation-checklist.xlsx) with the timeline and checkpoints.

Top-line success criteria (proposed):
- 3 core flows (Search, Recommend, Support-bot) meet precision/intent targets: baseline -> 10–15% improvement OR hit absolute thresholds described below.
- Latency: 95th percentile token latency <= 120ms during expected concurrency (50 users).
- Cost profile: per-session token cost within the target you shared during call (under $0.02/session).
- Integration: sample integration with your API (read-only) and the anonymized dataset ingested by the end of week 1.

Evaluation plan (3-week trial recommended):
1) Technical kickoff (week 0): environment access, data handoff, log/trace hooks — propose Tue 2027-02-22 10:00 PT.
2) Week 1: ingest + baseline runs; we validate end-to-end pipeline and surface quick wins.
3) Week 2: model tuning and throughput testing; run our suggested batching/quant profiles.
4) Week 3: final QA, metrics review, and executive wrap (final review meeting).

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood technical lead: Ben Carter (cc) — runtime config, test harness, infra.
- Redwood success lead: Mina Haddad — success criteria, evaluation.
- EmberTech data lead: Sam Park — data access, stakeholder alignment.
- EmberTech procurement: please nominate contact for SOW/PO.

Immediate asks from EmberTech:
- Provide an anonymized sample dataset (CSV) and a test API key for a sandbox account by Thu 2027-02-18.
- Confirm procurement contact for SOW/PO and whether an NDA is still needed.
- Confirm technical kickoff time or propose alternatives.

Attachments: poc-activation-checklist.xlsx (overview + timeline), redwood-sla-draft.pdf (SLA draft).

Short version: we want to run a 3-week evaluation that demonstrates measurable QA improvements while keeping costs predictable. If that looks good I’ll send an invite for the kickoff and upload a HubSpot playbook for tracking.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sam Park <sam.park@embertech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@embertech.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EmberTech trial kickoff — proposed activation checklist

Thanks Mina — this looks great and captures the discussion. A couple of quick clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: can we add a concrete target for the Support-bot flow? Aim for >=95% intent recognition on the top 3 intents for the sample queries we shared. If Redwood needs a different metric name, let us know.
- Data: we can provide an anonymized dataset (sample 50k rows) and a test API key by Thu 2027-02-18 as requested.
- Procurement: procurement@embertech.com is the shared mailbox; the procurement lead is Janet Li (janet.li@embertech.com) — she’ll be the PO signatory.

We’re good with the 3-week window. The proposed kickoff on Tue 2027-02-22 at 10:00 PT works for the engineering team.

On the timeline: we may want a short mid-point check (end of week 2) to assess whether we need an extra tuning sprint.

Forwarding our immediate action items below.

Sam

Nice recap Mina — happy to own the runtime/config side. A few internal notes and requests so we’re ready for the kickoff:

- Technical runbook: I’m preparing a short runbook with the exact test harness steps, sample curl commands, and the KV cache settings we recommend. I’ll attach that to the HubSpot deal and the Drive folder.
- Resource ask: we’ll allocate a single dedicated GPU instance for the first two load tests and enable continuous batching. That should keep token latency within the target while we iterate.
- Marissa — can you lead the success metric dashboard (post-run reports + diffs vs baseline)? We’ll need the metric definitions before the baseline run.

Action items (internal):
- Ben: deliver runbook + test harness by Fri 2027-02-19.
- Mina: finalize success criteria doc and invite stakeholders for kickoff (you already have this).
- Marissa: share dashboard template; coordinate with Sam on exact query set.

Attachments referenced: embertech-sample-data.csv (placeholder), poc-activation-checklist.xlsx (attached by Mina).

Ben Carter
